QuestInfo.name: First Greeting with Mrs. Ming Ming, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p229#, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out #p235# in front of #m10001007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p229#, the town clerk, asked me to greet #b#p203##k, a resident of the town. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the townspeople is a given, right?\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I greeted #p203#, a resident of #m10001000#. I have a feeling we're going to get along great!

0.0: "Since you've become a resident of #m10001000#, it would be a good idea to go greet the people here. As it happens, I've been wondering how #p203# is doing lately, so please go say hello to #p203#.\r\n- #p229#"

1.0: Hello there. I've seen you passing through this town a few times before, but what brings you here today?
1.1: Oh, you must be #h0#, the newest resident of our town. A very warm welcome to you. It's always such a pleasure to welcome a new neighbor, hoho.
1.2: Then I should introduce myself as well. I'm #p203#. I assist #p202# and take charge of various tasks needed around the town.
1.3: I do hope we can greet each other in the future. It was truly lovely meeting you today.

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, doesn't it?
